newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs rangebound, capped by 130.75.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs rangebound, capped by 130.75.

text.p: June BTP futures face a quiet day's trade capped by 130.75 on the upside and 130.00 on the downside, technical analysts said.

"We're going to see strong resistance around 130.75, which was around the higher levels on Friday," said Alfredo Granata, technical analyst at Banca di Roma in Rome. Charts show the market hit a daily high of 130.74 on Friday.

Granata said hopes of a long-awaited rate cut by the Bank of Italy this week was underpinning BTPs, which ticked up at the open despite weaker Bunds. By 0817 GMT, June BTPs were up 30 basis points at 130.45.
Granata put initial strong support at 130.00. "If this breaks, we're going to see a move towards 129.55 where good support has come in in the past."
Charts show the market hit a low of 129.53 on May 13 and 129.50 on May 14.
Independent technical analyst David Wood said BTPs would probably trade sideways on Monday.
He said the weak performance of the market on Friday had left it vulnerable to a slide to test 129.50.
"Then the next big support is from an old high down at 129.05, 129.00," he said.
Charts show the market hit daily highs of 129.05 on April 15 and April 17.
"It could be under pressure to hit those sorts of targets today by trading below 130.20,30," said Wood.
"If it can regain those levels then it would tend to confirm a bit of a base and project us back up to around 130.80."
By 0831 GMT, June Eurolira was up two basis points at 93.34.
